snippet.title: Mecha BREAK - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Mecha BREAK is launching July 1, 2025 on Steam and Xbox Series X|S! Pilots, are you ready to launch?

Take control of powerful Mecha units called "Strikers" in 3v3, 6v6, or PvPvE game modes.

Wishlist NOW

PC: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2452280/Mecha_BREAK/
Xbox: 
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/mecha-break/9n1bzs0v3k0c
